findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 稱旅行顧問仍是重要銷售通路，公司維持有競爭力的佣金與激勵，同時投資自家網站、App 與電商，讓賓客可端到端預訂；描述為並行投資、非通路結構性替換。
findings.excerpt: Travel advisors continue to be a significant sourcing channel of revenues for our ships. We believe in the value of this distribution channel and invest in maintaining strong relationships with our travel partners.

findings.claim: Royal Caribbean 計畫 2028 年前將私人目的地由3個增至8個，並於2027年進入河輪市場（平台化/業務擴張）。
findings.source: Cruise Industry News: Royal Caribbean Group Invests in Private Destination Strategy
